ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, shareholders and the franchise principal against the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit Politically Exposed Persons list, United Nations Security Council sanctions lists, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list, EU consolidated sanctions list, and Samoa domestic counter-terrorism financing list. PEPs must additionally undergo enhanced due diligence requiring source-of-wealth verification, senior management approval, and transaction monitoring for a minimum of 12 months.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) / Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour - International Companies Registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name must be submitted in Latin script and, if a native trade name is used, a complete transliteration into English or Samoan-acceptable Latin characters is mandatory. Chinese characters may only be registered as a secondary trading name after the statutory Latin-script name is cleared.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a written request for administrative review with the Samoan International Financial Authority within 14 business days of the rejection notice. The request must state the grounds of appeal and include any new evidence. If the review is unsuccessful, an appeal may be made to the Supreme Court of Samoa on a point of law. An extension of the initial name reservation may be applied to the Registrar no later than 7 days prior to expiration; single extension of up to 30 days is available upon payment of the statutory extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not permissible as a standalone registered office. A physical office maintained by a licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa is mandatory. A virtual address may be used only as an additional service address or correspondence address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — less than 1% annual probability for a low-risk, standard fast-casual franchise; however, records must remain accessible at the registered office to satisfy the Samoa International Financial Authority's inspection powers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended – registration, memorandum and articles, registered office, and director/secretary provisions.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC1 – Application for Registration of an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under the International Companies Act 1987; subscription may be credited as fully paid and no escrow account is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the Company adopts its registered Memorandum and Articles; (2) two thousand no-par ordinary shares are allotted to the subscriber as fully paid, no minimum capital being required; (3) the registered office is adopted at Apia, Samoa, through the licensed registered agent; (4) [Name] is appointed director and [Name] secretary, each holding office until removed, with authority to execute banking, licensing, and regulatory filings; and (5) any one director or the secretary may jointly verify and deliver statutory documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Licensed Registered Agent and Prepare Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA-licensed international service provider / registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute an engagement with a SIFA-licensed agent; prepare draft Memorandum and Articles of Association, beneficial ownership information, and registered office consent; align the commercial purpose with ISIC 5610 / NAICS 722513 fast-casual self-serve broth bowl licensing; no minimum capital subscription is required.
required_dossiers: Proposed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Identity documents for proposed directors and shareholders
Consent to act as registered office in Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the draft is deficient, the licensed agent issues a checklist of omissions and corrections must be completed within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve and Clear the Proposed Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Financial Authority – Name Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request containing the primary proposed name and up to three alternative names; verify that the name does not conflict with existing registered international or local companies; obtain written name clearance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of identity of the applicant or licensed agent
Name search fee confirmation (included in state filing fee)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name conflict is identified, substituted names are considered under the same application without a fresh fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Incorporation Application to the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC1 with the executed Memorandum and Articles, written consents of directors and secretary, registered office address confirmation, and statutory declarations; pay the official state filing fee of USD 200; the Registrar reviews the application for statutory conformity.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered office consent with Apia address
Notarized passports and proof of residential address for individual shareholders and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If queried, respond with corrected particulars within 14 calendar days; if rejected, amend and resubmit Form IC1 or request internal administrative review through SIFA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Procure Certificate of Incorporation and Verify Register Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation; verify the exact name, date, and particulars on the certificate and notify the licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical or factual error, apply to the Registrar for rectification of the certificate particulars.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convene First Board Meeting and Effect Corporate Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors / company secretary / licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the statutory first board meeting; adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution approving share allotment, registered office adoption, and officer appointments; issue share certificates; maintain statutory registers; and authorize the commencement of banking and restaurant business license applications.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening instructions and signatory list
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If quorum or disqualification is challenged, convene an adjourned meeting on valid notice or adopt a written resolution signed by all directors under the International Companies Act 1987.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) – Business Licensing Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence – Restaurant / Food and Beverage Service (Supplemented by Ministry of Health Food Service Establishment Permit)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) – Samoa Environment Division
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration – Small-Medium Food and Beverage Operation; Full EIA required only if wastewater exceeds 5 m³/day or the site is adjacent to sensitive receptors.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must meet Samoa Water Resources Management Regulations: pH 6–9, BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, oil and grease ≤ 10 mg/L; grease traps and covered grey-water conveyance are mandatory; no uncontrolled release of cooking VOCs, and all solid food waste must be handled by licensed waste contractors with no open burning.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire clearance from Samoa Fire and Rescue Services Authority; building occupancy and structural load inspection through the Planning and Urban Management Agency; and occupational health clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, including food-handler medical clearance for all kitchen staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR), Government of Samoa (successor to the Samoa Revenue Authority; merged with the former Customs Division), headquartered in Apia. Official taxpayer portal at www.revenue.gov.ws (MfR e-Services); customs and trade facilitation handled through the Samoa National Single Window (SNSW) running on ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Under the Tax Administration Act 2012 (s.28), every person carrying on a business in Samoa must obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) before commencing activity. The foreign-owned Samoa International Company (WS_IC) procures its TIN through a licensed registered agent: (1) the agent files the Taxpayer Registration Application (Form TIN/TA-01), together with the VAGST registration form where the IC expects taxable supplies in Samoa exceeding WST 100,000 in any 12-month period; (2) the application bundle comprises the Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Registered Office, certified copy of the Constitution, director/shareholder registers, and a certificate of good standing issued by the Samoa International Companies Registry; (3) MfR issues the TIN within approximately 5-10 business days; (4) where the IC relies on the statutory offshore-exempt regime, the agent submits the Tax Exemption Declaration / Certificate request under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) so the entity is recorded as tax-exempt; (5) a Samoa Business Licence under the Business Licences Act 2004 is required only if the IC conducts physical commercial activity inside Samoa - a pure offshore master-licensing operation with only a local registered office does not trigger that licence.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not operate a US-style check-the-box election. Available statutory elections for the WS_IC: (a) election to convert from international-company status to a domestic company (thereby accepting Entity_Level_Taxation at the standard company rate) if it chooses to conduct onshore Malatang operations; (b) election for a 5-year income-tax holiday under the Economic Development Incentives regime for qualifying onshore licensed restaurant or franchise-support activity; (c) VAGST group registration election under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 1992 for related Samoan entities; (d) reconstruction/amalgamation rollover elections under the Income Tax Act 2018 for intra-group reorganisation of franchise IP; (e) hybrid mismatch: no comprehensive check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch alignment election is available under Samoan domestic law; foreign-hybrid outcomes are governed by ordinary source and residence rules of the Income Tax Act 2018.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 of taxable supplies in any 12-month period (VAGST Act 1992, s.11); voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold; imported services supplied by a non-resident to a Samoan recipient may attract a recipient reverse charge, which is relevant to Samoan franchisees importing the Malatang brand licence.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa has no mandatory real-time electronic-invoicing or fiscal-clearance regime; no API-based digital stamping or e-invoice clearance platform exists. Taxpayers must issue and retain VAGST tax invoices for all taxable supplies (VAGST Act 1992, ss.23-24) and file returns electronically via the MfR e-Services portal; physical exports and imports are cleared electronically through ASYCUDA World via the Samoa National Single Window, which requires advance electronic customs declarations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available under the VAGST Act 1992 for (a) goods exported from Samoa, (b) services supplied to a non-resident person for use and enjoyment wholly outside Samoa, and (c) international freight and transport. The WS_IC's master-franchise licence and royalty income derived from non-resident Malatang franchisees qualifies as exported services at 0% where the licensed IP is exploited entirely outside Samoa and the franchisee is not physically present in Samoa. The claim must be substantiated with the executed Master Franchise Agreement, documentary proof of each franchisee's non-residence (e.g., foreign business registration certificate), the 0%-rated VAGST tax invoice, and bank credit evidence of the royalty wire; VAGST input credits attributable to the zero-rated export activity are refundable to the IC.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (lodged through ASYCUDA World) - required only for physical export of goods; a service-export declaration / zero-rated supply schedule flagged on the MfR portal replaces it for pure licensing royalties.

Bill of Lading / Air Waybill for tangible goods; for the Malatang master-licence, the executed Master Franchise Agreement, the 0%-rated VAGST tax invoice, and the franchisee's certificate of non-residence / foreign business registration.
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or bank SWIFT MT103 / credit advice evidencing receipt of franchise royalties in the WS_IC's Samoan bank account within the statutory repatriation window.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: MfR audits zero-rated export claims against the full documentation bundle and bank trail. Failure to substantiate triggers retrospective reversal of the zero-rating, clawback of all related input-credit refunds, and reassessment at 15% VAGST plus interest. Under the Tax Administration Act 2012, shortfall penalties escalate to 150% for intentional evasion, 90% for recklessness and 40% for failure to take reasonable care; criminal prosecution for false or misleading export declarations can lead to substantial fines and imprisonment of up to 5 years, and fraudulent customs declarations additionally attract penalties and forfeiture under the Customs Act 2014. Non-repatriation of export royalties within 180 days exposes the IC to exchange-control penalties under the Exchange Control Act 1976 (administered by the Central Bank of Samoa). In addition, the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2017 economic-substance rules apply: an IC claiming zero-rated offshore royalties without adequate substance or exchange-of-information compliance risks revocation of the statutory tax exemption and consequential grey-listing sanctions that deny treaty or zero-rating benefits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) – Exchange Control Department, operating under the Exchange Control Act 1975 and the Central Bank Act 1984
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) operates under a managed float with exchange controls administered by the CBS. Capital account transactions by residents are restricted and require prior CBS approval; current account transactions such as royalty and service payments are generally permitted but must be effected through an authorized dealer (licensed commercial bank). Non-resident-owned International Companies (ICs) that conduct business exclusively in foreign currency and do not transact with Samoan residents enjoy broad exemptions from exchange controls. Profit remittance hurdles are accordingly low, provided the IC maintains a designated foreign-currency account, submits a certified board resolution for each dividend or royalty outflow, and demonstrates absence of any Samoan taxable activity via the IC tax-exemption certificate. Convertibility for ICs is thus effectively assured for current account flows and foreign-currency capital movements, while any incidental WST conversion remains subject to CBS approval and standard authorized-dealer oversight.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBS exchange-control practice, exporters of goods and services must repatriate export proceeds to Samoa within 180 days from the date of shipment or service completion, and surrender 100% of the proceeds to an authorized dealer within 30 days of receipt. A general or specific exemption is available for International Companies that are non-resident-owned and operate in foreign currency; such entities may retain export proceeds in an approved foreign-currency external account without mandatory surrender. For a Malatang fast-casual franchise generating royalty income from China, the exemption should be invoked by describing each remittance as 'franchise royalty – foreign services' and maintaining a documented trail of underlying service agreements to avoid inadvertent mandatory conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD) and Operational Account (USD)
Operational Account (USD/WST) and Capital Escrow Account
Basic Operational Account (WST) – restricted for offshore IC

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs (e.g. Payoneer, Wise, and similar electronic money institutions) are not licensed banks in Samoa and are not recognized as authorized dealers under the Central Bank of Samoa's exchange-control framework. Their viability for a Samoa IC is Low to Medium. A small number of established EMIs accept Pacific-registered companies, but they impose enhanced due diligence and usually require an existing physical-bank relationship for outgoing wires. Legal constraints include the CBS rule that all Samoan-resident payments must be routed through an authorized dealer; EMIs cannot hold WST or provide MT103 clearing on behalf of Samoan ICs. EMIs may be used only as a supplementary receiving mechanism for foreign-currency royalty inflows when the underlying funds do not touch the Samoan domestic banking system, and never as the sole treasury rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Samoa's licensed banks, acting under the Central Bank's AML/CFT Rules, require a face-to-face interview with at least one director or authorized signatory. For non-resident directors, a live video call conducted by a compliance officer may satisfy the personal appearance requirement, but full remote online opening is not permitted. In addition to the interview, the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) must submit certified identity documents, proof of address, and source-of-wealth documentation. The recognized alternative to a director's physical travel is appointment of a local agent under a notarized power of attorney, followed by an in-branch verification at the local agent's office.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore / International Company structure with tax-exempt status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original IC certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, Samoan tax-exemption certificate, legal opinion confirming legitimate non-tax-avoidance purpose, and a comprehensive business plan for the Chinese Malatang franchise roll-out.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership concentrated among Chinese or Pacific individuals with rapid cross-border equity moves
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copies of all shareholders' passports, proof of residential address, bank references from the remitting overseas bank, detailed source-of-wealth declarations, corporate registry extracts, and a transparent beneficial-ownership chart.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Repeated royalty and franchise-fee payments to China-based brand HQ
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly executed franchise and license agreement, royalty calculation schedule, periodic invoices consistent with the agreement, transfer pricing benchmark showing an arm's-length rate, and evidence of active brand usage and quality inspections.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of local agent or registered-office only without physical business presence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-office certificate, agency agreement with the Samoan service provider, lease or service letter, local agent's AML/KYC compliance certificate, and audited financial statements demonstrating operational continuity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections from a Chinese shareholder or parent will be executed via SWIFT MT103 from the overseas remitting bank to the IC's USD-denominated operational account at a Samoan authorized dealer. The wire must carry a purpose code aligned with Samoa's BOP-compliant classification, specifically code 'EQUI' or the equivalent designation for 'Direct Investment Equity Capital'. The receiving bank will verify the identity and sanctions status of the remitter, the compliance of the 72 additional remittance information lines, and will require the IC to present a board resolution authorizing the capital increase, an updated register of members, a source-of-funds declaration, and any underlying share-subscription or contribution agreement. Since the IC is non-resident-owned, no prior CBS approval is required for the deposit of foreign currency, but the bank conducts an internal exchange-control check and may require a written statement from the IC's local agent confirming that the funds will not be converted into WST without CBS consent.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and royalty disbursements will be cleared through two primary rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for routine franchise royalties, supply-chain deposits, and intangible service fees; and (ii) an irrevocable commercial letter of credit for large equipment purchases such as Malatang cooking stations, self-serve broth dispensers, and mechanical packaging units. For MT103 instructions, the IC's Samoan bank will transmit funds from the USD operational account to the Chinese beneficiary's bank using purpose code 'FRAN' / 'Royalties' or the CBS-mapped BOP service category, attaching invoice numbers and the reference to the underlying license agreement. For letter-of-credit transactions, the Samoan bank issues the LC at the IC's request backed by funds or a cash margin, with documents including commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, and quality certificate. All outbound payments made from foreign-currency accounts avoid Samoa exchange-control conversion procedures; any payment requiring WST debit is subject to CBS filing and may require evidence of the underlying commercial transaction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/WST forward contracts with a licensed Samoan commercial bank, generally up to a 12-month tenor
Cross-currency swaps between USD and WST, subject to Central Bank of Samoa case-by-case approval for non-financial corporate hedgers
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing WST, executed with an eligible global counterparty, provided settlement occurs outside Samoa
Natural hedging through operational multi-currency accounts and intra-group netting of franchise royalties against supply-cost payables

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal Payment for International Company (Annual Government Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies – Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; payment must be effected on or before the anniversary date each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment penalty of 10% for each commenced month of default or WST 100, whichever is higher; continued non-payment for six months may trigger a show-cause notice and administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company (Corporate Details and Registered Office Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies – Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fee per month or part-month prescribed by the Registrar; repeated default for two consecutive years may result in Registrar-initiated dissolution after notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Compliance Certificate (Filed by the Licensed Samoan Registered Agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry (submitted through the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may lead to removal of the registered agent's licence and the company being struck off the International Companies Register with reinstatement only through court order.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit for a standard Samoa International Company. A mandatory independent audit applies only where the company holds a Samoan banking, insurance, money-services, or securities licence, or where shareholders holding at least 5% of the voting shares require an audit pursuant to the International Companies Act.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) is the expected framework for any voluntarily prepared financial statements; the Samoa International Companies Act does not require statutory filing of accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public annual UBO filing is made for a Samoa International Company. The registered agent is required to obtain an annual confidential confirmation from the ultimate beneficial owners at each anniversary date and to update the internal beneficial-ownership register promptly upon any share transfer. A transfer of shares is effective only after the Register of Members is updated; any transfer also requires a mandatory UBO-register update within 14 days and notice to the registered agent.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 – USD 1,200 per annum (registered agent and registered office in Samoa)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (mandatory audit not applicable); voluntary IFRS audit typically USD 3,500 – USD 8,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company tax-exempt zone: full exemption from Samoa income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty on offshore income and international transactions; only a fixed annual Government fee is payable. A fast-casual self-serve broth bowl master licensing IC holding IP and receiving overseas royalties qualifies as tax-exempt if no Samoan-source income is derived.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa International Company Annual Declaration (IC Form 1) submitted through the Samoa International Finance Authority online filing system
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before 31 March following the financial year end; if the IC's financial year is not the calendar year, within three months after the year end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mark 'Yes' only if the IC has not carried on business with Samoan residents and has not earned income sourced in Samoa; otherwise file an IR 510 return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose each Chinese shareholder or corporate parent; attach a realistic shareholding chart.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the Samoan office, full-time employees, physical equipment, and core entrepreneurial activities in Samoa; mere mailbox substance is non-compliant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Execution by director or registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident director may sign electronically, or the licensed registered agent may affix signature under a power of attorney, keeping a notarised copy in the corporate register.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of WST 500 plus daily accrual of WST 50 up to WST 10,000; continued default triggers deregistration, restoration costs, and loss of the statutory tax exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Company Income Tax Return form IR 510, lodged through Samoa Inland Revenue's Taxpayer Online Services e-portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the fiscal year end; a calendar-year taxpayer must file and pay by 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from all Samoa-source business activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only income with a Samoan source; offshore royalties from Chinese and third-country master franchisees are excluded under the IC exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt income schedule, including International Company offshore profits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a detailed exemption schedule supported by franchise agreements and bank transaction summaries.
If the IC inadvertently earned Samoan-source income, claim only expenses directly incurred in producing that income; do not allocate offshore group overheads.

Complete the treaty relief schedule only if Samoan-source royalties or interest remain exposed; attach a Samoa Inland Revenue issued Certificate of Residence or the corresponding Chinese tax office residence certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable or refund due at 27%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute 27% of assessable income, credit any treaty relief and valid foreign tax credits, and remit the net amount.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of tax due, additional 2% monthly surcharge up to 50%, and interest at 10% per annum; criminal prosecution possible for wilful non-filing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for distributions from a Samoa International Company's offshore profits; the standard dividend withholding tax for a taxable resident Samoan company is 15%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: IC dividend distributions are statutorily exempt and do not require a DTA application. For any residually taxed Samoan-source dividend, interest, or royalty, the non-resident payee must submit Form IR 650 'Application for Treaty Relief' to the Samoa Inland Revenue, attach the tax residency certificate issued by the Chinese tax authority, and obtain a Samoa Certificate of Residence before the withholding rate is reduced. The payer must retain signed declarations and the approved relief notice for six years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory non-resident rates: royalties 15%, interest 15%, dividends 15% when paid by a taxable Samoan company. Under the Samoa-China double taxation agreement, where applicable, royalties and interest may be reduced to 10% if the recipient is the beneficial owner. No Samoan withholding tax arises on offshore royalties paid into a tax-exempt Samoa IC for the Chinese malatang master licensing model.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required when connected-party cross-border transactions exceed WST 5 million per year; Master File required where the multinational group's consolidated turnover exceeds WST 50 million per year.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019 apply to the IP business of master licensing self-serve broth bowl franchises. The IC must have a physical office in Samoa, a sufficient number of full-time employees, adequate operating expenditure, core decision-making activity in Samoa, and must file an Annual Economic Substance Declaration. Pure paper holding of the malatang brand IP without active Samoan management triggers substantial penalties and potential exchange of information to the Chinese tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Artificial Profit Stripping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Samoa IC as an invoicing conduit for Chinese malatang franchise royalties at non-arm's-length rates while maintaining no real Samoan staff or office, or deliberately concealing Samoan-source cash sales from the IC declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Commissioner of Inland Revenue may tax 27% on deemed Samoan-source income, impose a 100% to 200% civil penalty on the tax shortfall, apply overdue interest at 10% per annum, and strike the International Company off the register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow officers are jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes, penalties, and interest; the court may grant travel bans and custodial sentences up to seven years under the Samoa Income Tax Act 2015.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a false Annual Declaration stating zero Samoan-source activity while the IC physically operates, manages, or receives payments through Samoan POS points-of-sale, or failing to disclose that the nominal Samoa IP owner is a bare nominee for the Chinese operator.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to WST 100,000, immediate deregistration, mandatory strike-off, and a five-year prohibition against re-registering an international company under substantially similar control.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director may be personally fined up to WST 50,000, disqualified from managing any Samoan company for ten years, and ordered to pay civil restitution to the IC's creditors or franchisees.
